title.narrative: Vanuatu Affordable and Resilient Settlements Project

description.narrative: The PDO is to: (i) improve access to and resilience of infrastructure and services in selected new and existing settlements, and (ii) strengthen land planning and management for resilient human settlement.

The development objective of the Affordable and Resilient Settlements Project for Vanuatu is to: (i) improve access to and resilience of infrastructure and services in selected new and existing settlements, and (ii) strengthen land planning and management for resilient human settlement. The project comprises of four components. The first component, affordable and resilient new settlement development will develop a new urban expansion area on 10 ha of public land in Etas, able to accommodate approximately 171 households. It consists of following sub-components: (i) resilient new settlement development; and (ii) institutional and systems strengthening for future settlement planning and development. The second component, affordable and resilient settlement upgrading will improve access to infrastructure and urban resilience through upgrading tertiary infrastructure in informal settlements and delivery of trunk drainage in priority flood affected areas in Port Vila. It consists of following sub-components: (i) resilient settlement upgrading; (ii) sustainable urban drainage for settlements; and (iii) institutional and systems strengthening for upgrading unplanned settlements. The third component, strengthening institutional capacity for implementation and sustainability will finance technical assistance to improve urban management, service delivery, resilience, and project management. The fourth component, contingent emergency response will allow for rapid reallocation of uncommitted project funds towards urgent needs in the event of a disaster (geophysical, or climate-related), or public health emergency.

condition.narrative: Mid Term Review Loan Agreement: Schedule 2, Section II(2),The Recipient shall carry out, jointly with the Association, not laterthan three (3) years after the Effective Date, or such other period as may be agreed with the Association, a mid-term review of theProject (the “Mid-Term Review”) to assess the status of Project implementation, as measured against the Project indicatorsacceptable to the Association, and compliance with the legal covenants included or referred to in this Agreement. Such reviewshall include an assessment of the following: (a) overall progress in implementation; (b) results of monitoring and evaluationactivities; (c) progress on procurement and disbursement; (d) progress on implementation of safeguards measures; (e) implementationarrangements and Project staff turnover; and (f) the need to make any adjustments to the Project to improve performance.

Project Management Unit Loan Agreement: Schedule 2, Section I.A (3),The Recipient shall, no later than two (2) months after theEffective Date (or such other date which the Association has confirmed in writing to the Recipient is reasonable and acceptableunder the circumstances, as determined by the Association in its sole discretion), establish and maintain until the Closing Date, aProject Management Unit (PMU) within the MoLNR, with a mandate, composition and resources satisfactory to the Association.

Project Operations Manual Loan Agreement: Schedule 2, Section I.A (4),By no later than two (2) months after the Effective Date(or such other date which the Association has confirmed in writing to the Recipient is reasonable and acceptable under thecircumstances, as determined by the association in its sole discretion), the Recipient shall prepare and furnish to the Associationa Project Operational Manual.

Project ReportsLoan Agreement: Schedule 2, Section II(1),The Recipient shall furnish to the Association each Project Report notlater than one month after the end of each calendar semester, covering the calendar semester. Except as may otherwise be explicitlyrequired or permitted under this Agreement or as may be explicitly requested by the Association, in sharing any information, reportor document related to the activities described in Schedule 1 to this Agreement, the Recipient shall ensure that such information,report or document does not include Personal Data

Project Steering Committee Loan Agreement: Schedule 2, Section I.A (1),The Recipient shall, no later than one (1) month afterthe Effective Date (or such other date which the Association has confirmed in writing to the Recipient is reasonable and acceptableunder the circumstances, as determined by the Association in its sole discretion), establish and maintain until the Closing Date, aProject Steering Committee, with a mandate, composition and resources satisfactory to the Association.

Technical Working Group Loan Agreement: Schedule 2, Section I.A (2),The Recipient shall, no later than three (3) months afterthe Effective Date (or such other date which the Association has confirmed in writing to the Recipient is reasonable and acceptableunder the circumstances, as determined by the Association in its sole discretion), establish and maintain until the Closing Date, aTechnical Working Group under the Project Steering Committee, with a mandate, composition and resources satisfactory to theAssociation.
